item.title: Morning brief, Thursday November 19
item.description: Good morning Sydney. Today is Vegas day. Rain is likely in Venice this morning, heaviest from 7 to 10, so leave extra time for the airport. Check your United flight times in the app. Tonight is Beyond the Apex at the Stirling Club, with afterparty doors at 8. Remember someone needs to let the hot tub guy in Friday at 7 AM. Have a great trip.
